validity.recommendation: Keep the row (pipeline is real), but replace the generic Apache-EIA citation with sources that actually name the Salam->Abu Gharadig line; the sheet's only cited source does not document this pipeline.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Real. The Salam gas field feeds the Western Desert Gas Complex hub at Abu Gharadig, and both ends are independently documented: offshore-technology.com describes the Salam Gas Plant (Khalda/Apache, ~600 MMcf/d gas + condensate), and petro-news.com (Arabic) describes the Abu Gharadig gas field/plant operated by Khalda Petroleum. GulfPub PE World Map independently carries a matching 18-inch line 'Western Desert Gas Project - South Line' from Salam field -> Abu Gharadiq GP. HOWEVER, the row's ONLY cited source is the 2004 Apache Egypt EIA intro PDF on MIGA (miga.org). I fetched and read that PDF (only 5 pages, the cover/contents/introduction of a longer EIA): it establishes Apache's 100% Khalda Concession interest and the Khalda Petroleum Company (Apache+EGPC) JV, but it NEVER names this pipeline and gives NO length/diameter/capacity. It is a generic citation, so the existing ref does not support the specific specs -> flagged. CLASSIFICATION: correct -- gas transmission trunk within the Western Desert Gas Complex feeder system, not oil/condensate, not plant-internal. DUPLICATE: not a duplicate. It is a distinct segment (Salam->Abu Gharadig, 18 in) of the WDGP-South corridor; the downstream Abu Gharadig->Dahshour leg is a separate row (P3939, 24 in) and the short Salam spur is P6693 (22 in). GulfPub splits the same corridor into features too but the endpoints/diameters keep P0476 distinct.

validity.recommendation: Verify LengthKnown (GEM 212 km vs GulfPub 296 km, ~28% delta) and Capacity (187 MMcf/d has NO independent corroboration). Diameter 18 in is corroborated by GulfPub only (Tier-2); seek a second source.
validity.researcher_notes: SPEC: Diameter 18 in agrees with GulfPub's WDGP-South Line (18 in) -> single independent Tier-2 corroboration (medium). Length: GEM 212 km vs GulfPub 296 km for the same Salam->Abu Gharadiq line -- material ~28% disagreement, no independent media source pins either figure; straight-line Salam->Abu Gharadig is ~120-150 km so a routed 212 km is plausible but unconfirmed. Capacity 187 MMcf/d: NO independent source found; the WDGC total intake is ~900 MMcf/d from Salam+Obaiyed+others, so 187 is plausible as the Salam-line share but is uncorroborated (GulfPub Capacity_mmcfd=300 is a placeholder, ignored). None of these three numbers is supported by the sheet's cited Apache EIA. Not deep-filling with a citable ref because no independent URL states the specific 212/18/187 values.

validity.recommendation: Recheck operator vs owner: the operating company is Khalda Petroleum Company (Apache+EGPC JV); 'Apache Corp 100%' reflects Apache's 100% contractor interest in the Khalda Concession (per 2004 EIA) but omits the EGPC/JV structure and is dated (APA/Apache; Sinopec holds a one-third stake in Apache's Egypt interests since 2013).
validity.researcher_notes: ATTRIBUTION: GEM Owner1 = Apache Corp 100%. The 2004 Apache EIA states Apache holds a 100% interest in the Khalda/Khalda Offset Concession and is operator, with Khalda Petroleum Company (KPC) the EGPC JV vehicle. offshore-technology confirms Salam plant sponsors as Khalda Petroleum / Apache / EGPC / EGAS; petro-news confirms Khalda Petroleum currently operates the Abu Gharadig field/gas line. So the OPERATOR is Khalda Petroleum Company, not 'Apache Corp' bare. GulfPub attributes the WDGP-South operator to BAPETCO (Badr El Din) -- that is BAPETCO's Obaiyed/BED role, not the Salam-Khalda segment, so GulfPub's operator here is unreliable. Recommend recording operator = Khalda Petroleum Company and owner = Apache/EGPC JV rather than Apache 100%.

routes.end_name: Abu Gharadig gas field / Western Desert Gas Complex hub, Matruh, Western Desert
routes.corridor_desc: Southeasterly overland corridor across the northern Western Desert (Matruh governorate) from the Salam/Khalda ridge fields near Qasr down to the Abu Gharadig field and Western Desert Gas Complex gathering hub. Both endpoints are named-facility confirmed; the intervening corridor is NOT precisely bounded from open sources. Coordinates given are APPROXIMATE regional centroids of the two named fields (roughly +/-20-30 km), defensible from the fields' documented Western Desert / Abu Gharadig Basin locations, not surveyed pipeline vertices.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints (Salam gas field -> Abu Gharadig) independently confirmed by name. I could NOT independently source a precise route trace, so lat/lon are approximate field centroids explicitly labeled as such (no coordinate fabricated to false precision). The sheet's 'high' RouteAccuracy is not supported by anything I could verify from open media; endpoints support at most a medium corridor. Downstream context: Abu Gharadig -> Dahshour is the separate P3939 leg.

summary: P0476 is a real, correctly-classified WDGP-South gas feeder (Salam->Abu Gharadig, Khalda-operated), not a duplicate; but the sole cited ref (2004 Apache EIA) never names it, owner should be Khalda JV not bare Apache, and length 212 km (vs GulfPub 296) + capacity 187 MMcf/d are uncorroborated.
